use_cases.title: Open Today and execute the next action
use_cases.flow: System loads today's cross-module agenda; user completes/starts an action; state and progress update.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Create a habit or routine
use_cases.flow: User selects context, schedule/target, reminder/integration, and optional goal link; system validates and saves.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Create a long-term goal and phases
use_cases.flow: User creates goal, phases, milestones, success criteria, and optional linked habits/tasks.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Navigate the goal map
use_cases.flow: User opens Map, selects an island/phase, inspects milestone status, and continues the next available step.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Recover after missed activity
use_cases.precondition: One or more scheduled actions were missed.
use_cases.flow: System shows a recovery summary, preserves historical continuity, and lets user resume, reschedule, or intentionally skip.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Review progress and insights
use_cases.flow: User selects time range/domain; system shows consistency, milestone progress, trends, and recommended review points.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Switch life modules without losing context
use_cases.flow: User switches from one top-level/module context to another and later returns to the prior state.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Use external data to auto-complete progress
use_cases.flow: System ingests eligible external signal, maps it to a tracked item, updates progress once, and exposes provenance.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Collaborate with family on an opt-in goal
use_cases.flow: Owner shares selected goal; collaborator sees only authorized data and contributes progress.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Submit and approve an AI-generated feature request
use_cases.precondition: AI capture and admin role available.
use_cases.flow: User records request; AI creates structured proposal; admin edits/approves/rejects; approved item enters beta workflow with audit trail.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Import a learning course
use_cases.flow: User supplies source links; AI extracts candidate modules/lessons/activities; user reviews before saving.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Review financial goal projection
use_cases.flow: User opens a financial goal, reviews current assumptions/imported values and projected trajectory, and updates assumptions explicitly.
use_cases.exceptions: Permission, validation, offline retry or empty state is handled explicitly without unintended writes.

use_cases.title: Run a focused work session
use_cases.precondition: A workspace and optional task exist
use_cases.flow: Select task, start session, pause/resume and finish; record eligible duration
use_cases.exceptions: Interruptions are recorded without awarding duplicate XP

use_cases.title: Log water intake
use_cases.precondition: Workspace and local date are configured
use_cases.flow: Choose serving or enter volume, confirm, inspect day total and target
use_cases.exceptions: Corrections must update aggregate once

use_cases.title: Import and reconcile financial data
use_cases.precondition: Finance access and spreadsheet export are available
use_cases.flow: Connect or upload, preview mappings, resolve duplicates, confirm, review categories
use_cases.exceptions: Reject invalid currency/date; never modify source without authorization

use_cases.title: Review multi-currency savings and projections
use_cases.flow: Set month, accounts, currencies, scenarios and view account transfers, savings and forecasts
use_cases.exceptions: Uncertain FX estimates are labeled; remittances not double counted

use_cases.title: Track reading and predict finish date
use_cases.flow: Enter pages read with date; see pace window and estimated finish; mark complete
use_cases.exceptions: Insufficient history displays no false certainty

use_cases.title: Add a movie recommendation
use_cases.precondition: User can edit personal movie queue
use_cases.flow: Enter or dictate film, recommender and notes; inspect rating provenance and sort
use_cases.exceptions: Unavailable ratings remain explicitly unknown

use_cases.title: Track game play time
use_cases.flow: Start, pause/resume and stop timer; inspect total game hours
use_cases.exceptions: Duplicate stop and device retries do not double count

use_cases.title: Capture a memory and search it
use_cases.flow: Create text/voice note, review transcription, attach image, search and open
use_cases.exceptions: Private media is access checked; errors keep original content

use_cases.title: Connect external calendar
use_cases.precondition: Provider authorization and available event permissions
use_cases.flow: Authorize scoped access; show agenda; link task; revoke access
use_cases.exceptions: Revocation removes future access but preserves user-owned work

use_cases.title: Convert spoken request to daily task
use_cases.flow: Speak, review structured draft, correct, approve and save
use_cases.exceptions: Low-confidence parsing and rejection create no task

use_cases.title: Propose tasks from GitHub issues
use_cases.precondition: Scoped connector and selected project or repo are available
use_cases.flow: Read issues, select suggestions, preview and explicitly accept tasks
use_cases.exceptions: No external issue is silently edited

use_cases.title: Invite family member to shared goal
use_cases.precondition: An account and private goal exist
use_cases.flow: Invite member, select permission, share goal, revoke access
use_cases.exceptions: Unshared user data stays inaccessible

use_cases.title: Switch responsive display mode
use_cases.flow: Open desktop/mobile mode setting; switch; preserve route and unsaved safe UI context
use_cases.exceptions: Essential actions remain available in both modes

use_cases.title: Review proposed CV update
use_cases.flow: Inspect suggested entry; edit and approve; publish to own CV
use_cases.exceptions: No auto-publication without approval

use_cases.title: Export or delete personal data
use_cases.flow: Choose portable export or deletion workflow; confirm; receive status/evidence
use_cases.exceptions: Other users' content excluded; retention exceptions disclosed

use_cases.title: Audit user storage quota
use_cases.precondition: Admin role and storage telemetry exist
use_cases.flow: View quota, warn user, reject oversized new uploads and inspect user controls
use_cases.exceptions: Never expose private attachment content in quota UI

use_cases.title: Track an avoid/negative habit
use_cases.precondition: Habit definition includes severity and a valid recurrence rule
use_cases.flow: Record occurrence, inspect elapsed-since and severity impact; correct accidental log
use_cases.exceptions: No irreversible penalty or hidden user shame mechanic

use_cases.title: Roll out approved beta feature
use_cases.precondition: Feature proposal approved and cohort defined
use_cases.flow: Select cohort, deploy gated version, monitor, revert; record decision
use_cases.exceptions: No release before approval and security/functional gates

use_cases.title: Log exercise progress
use_cases.flow: Create activity session, enter metrics, optionally attach to goal
use_cases.exceptions: No medical diagnoses inferred from raw fitness entries

use_cases.title: Import handwritten notebook
use_cases.flow: Upload, preview extracted pages, confirm association with notes
use_cases.exceptions: Failed imports leave existing notes unchanged

use_cases.title: Navigate the achievement and low-game modes
use_cases.flow: Open Me, inspect earned rewards, switch theme; return to tasks
use_cases.exceptions: Progress and essential actions unaffected by theme choice
